dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, I'm hungry. Let's get something to eat.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, aɪm ˈhʌŋɡri. ˈlɛts ˈɡɛt ˈsʌmθɪŋ tə ˈiːt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. Excuse me, do you have sandwiches?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ɪkˈskjuːz miː, duː juː ˈhæv ˈsænwɪtʃɪz?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes. Chicken or egg. We have toast, too.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ˈtʃɪkən ɔːr ˈɛɡ. wiː ˈhæv ˈtoʊst, ˈtuː.
